description: This Java class 'Password' represents an entity used in a change password page within a web application's admin section. It encapsulates password-related fields and associates with a 'User' object.

classes.name: Password
classes.description: Entity used in the change password page, holding password fields and associated user.

methods.name: getRepeatPassword
methods.description: Returns the repeated new password for confirmation.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User object with this password entity.
